subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

Cc: Jared Thompson <jared.thompson@finpath.com>

Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

Hi Maya / Jared,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — really appreciated the context on your multi-product roadmap and the throughput goals for customer-facing search. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- What I heard: FinPath wants a low-latency, cost-predictable embedding search for transaction data and summaries, with strict audit logging and a private deployment option for regulated clients.
- Next meeting: demo + technical deep dive where we can show latency/cost profiles, deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and answer security/procurement questions.
- Stakeholders: you mentioned looping in security and procurement — happy to include them.

Can you share 2-3 windows next week that work for a 60-75 minute technical demo? I’ve added a Calendly link below but happy to work around your calendars if needed.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/redwood-demo

I’ve attached a short demo deck so you can share internally.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

- Thu 5/12: 09:30-11:00 PT

- Quick recap & goals (Marissa)
- Live demo (Marissa)
